company.summary: VARD ELECTRO AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under bygging av sivile skip og flytende materiell (NACE 30.110), based in Haram, founded 1997-05-20. Its verified website describes it as: “VARD is a global shipbuilder delivering specialized offshore, seafood and security vessels. Part of Fincantieri Group, ~950 ships delivered. See our services.” Public brand: VARD. Registered activity: Drive elektroinstallasjon, samt konsulenttjenester til landbasert og maritim relatert industri. Dessuten drive handel med varer med tilhørighet til bransjen. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 2.5 bn, operating result NOK 91.5 m, net result NOK 58.5 m, total assets NOK 2.3 bn, equity NOK 357.6 m. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 2.6 bn to NOK 2.5 bn (-5%); net result went from NOK 105.1 m to NOK 58.5 m (-44%); equity went from NOK 365.1 m to NOK 357.6 m (-2%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin 3.7%; equity ratio 15.8%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 419. Leadership in the official register: Hans Tore Jenssen (managing director); Andrea Qualizza (chair of the board); Giovanni Peditto (board member); Geir Ove Grønli (board member); plus 16 further roles. 2 registered workplaces in Sandefjord, Tennfjord. Official website https://www.vard.com/ (identity check: registry declared homepage); company-linked profiles on instagram, linkedin. Appears to be hiring: 1 active job ad with an exact employer match (Senior Engineer - MB/LV Switchgear ). Latest company-published activity: “Press release 25. September 2026 Havbryn named in Ålesund - VARD-built stern trawler marks a new chapter for Havbryn AS Read more” (2026-09-25). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12).
